title: Anchor API
description: Reference for Anchor Astro component.
headings: Anchor Container element. Scopes the anchor to its content. The content the floating content is anchored to. default The floating content. anchored alignment Any valid `position-area` value. Controls where the floating content is placed. id The id of the floating content when `trigger` is `"hover"`. Generated when omitted. trigger Shows the floating content always, or on hover and focus with `popover="hint"`.

Controls where the floating content is placed. [popover="hint"] Trigger Shows the floating content always, or on hover and focus with `popover="hint"`.

title: Avatar API
description: Reference for Avatar Astro component.
headings: Avatar Container element. The avatar image. src alt alt Alternative text for the image. as The element to render. Defaults to `"a"` with `href`, otherwise `"div"`. command The command to send to the `commandfor` target. commandfor The id of the element the command targets. disabled Disables the avatar when `as` is `"button"`. href The link to use. Renders an `<a>`. interestfor The id of the element to show on interest. isGroup Renders a container that groups avatars. src The image source. Replaces the default slot. variant The variant to use.

title: Avatar API
description: Reference for Avatar HTML component.
headings: .ui-avatar Container element. The avatar image. img The element to render. Defaults to `"a"` with `href`, otherwise `"div"`. The command to send to the `commandfor` target. The id of the element the command targets. Disables the avatar when `as` is `"button"`. The link to use. Renders an `<a>`. The id of the element to show on interest. [role="group"] Group Renders a container that groups avatars. .ui-rounded .ui-squared .ui-squircle Variants The variant to use.
